what: Final blocking approach aligned: purely ID-coverage based. Block if unrecalled IDs + new file. Soft if unrecalled IDs + encountered before. Silent if all IDs covered or no memories. Directory trigger likely redundant with ID-based checking — individual file recalls already cover directory-scoped memories via scopeMatchesPath. PostToolUse DOES fire for MCP tools — fix was one jq path change (tool_response is array of {type,text}). Session-inject writes injected IDs to tracking at SessionStart so injected memories don't cause redundant blocking.
why: Aligned on the correct blocking approach after extensive discussion. ID coverage is the single source of truth for blocking decisions.
